validated_event_composition.composition_coordinate: per-event exact hadronic invariant mass W
validated_event_composition.CC_ud: ALEPH tau spectral functions through W=1.65 GeV, followed by the source-projected continuation
validated_event_composition.CC_us: data-tied resonance cocktail; explicit K pole excluded
validated_event_composition.NC_ud: OPAL/tau-normalized light-current construction through W=1.65 GeV, followed by the source-projected continuation
validated_event_composition.NC_s: data-tied strange-current construction through W=1.65 GeV, followed by the source-projected continuation
validated_event_composition.CC_cd: charged c dbar continuum with the explicit single-D row removed
validated_event_composition.CC_cs: charged c sbar continuum with the explicit single-Ds row removed

_comment: EventCalc owns every explicit pole and exclusive row. exhad replaces only the selected Jets-* subsystem, preserves its exact four-vector and W, and covers all six currents with positive installed production weight through 5.27 GeV. Set EXHAD_BENCH=raw (or choose default fragmentation in the host prompt) only for the comparison sample.
